properties.site-address: St Cuthberts RC First School, Links Road, Amble
properties.notes: Site of former school that is now closed, has been declared surplus and is therefore available for redevelopment. Planning permission has been granted for demolition and redevelopment of the land for 14 town houses and bungalows (17/01123/FUL). Development is now underway and anticipated to be complete within the next 5 years. The footprint of development is limited to brownfield land and does not included wider site and playing fields.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
